requirements.text: Replace the existing widget on the Home page with a static image widget displaying the generated Angel aesthetics image (angel-aesthetics.png). The new widget must occupy the exact same position and layout space as the widget it replaces.

acceptanceCriteria: The previous widget is removed from the Home page
